people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.
translations.bsb: Now the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there, for it was the great high place. Solomon offered a thousand burnt offerings on the altar there.
translations.kjv: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
translations.asv: And the king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt-offerings did Solomon offer upon that altar.
